caption: The screen Welcome back of Gelato (title Log in to Gelato) to which the Shopify app sent us right after the install: Continue with Apple, Continue with Facebook, Continue with Google, a field Email, a field Password, Remember me, Forgot Password? and the button Sign in; on the right an advert for new apparel brands in the US with the Gelato+ label. The photo of a model in the advert is hidden.

The Pricing block of the Shopify App Store listing of Gelato Print on Demand: the Install button, the developer Gelato, and two plans, Gelato Free (Free to install, Pay for what you print) and Gelato+ ($29.99 a month, or $239.88 a year and save 33%, with up to 33% off products, exclusive tools, Magic Mockups, Instant Collections, Price Navigator and Product Migration with Velocity Switch). The small account icon at the top right of the App Store header is hidden.

The Details step of the product wizard (Product, Design, Details) in the Gelato dashboard: a mockup of a white T-shirt with the text Test Print on the chest, the title Classic Unisex Crewneck T-shirt | Gildan 64000 White, a description with the fabric text, the note Progress saved in Drafts and the buttons Save as template and Save. Nothing was saved or published and the draft was deleted afterwards.

The pop-up Welcome to Gelato+! in the Gelato dashboard: Product discounts (Not applied on trial: up to 33% off products, skip the trial to start getting discounts on your next order), Personalization Studio, AI Tools & Premium design assets, Unlimited stores & users, and the buttons Start 14-day free trial and Skip trial and activate discounts now; behind it the menu and a product in Draft. Neither button was clicked. The account icon at the top right and the picture of a person in the advert on the right of the pop-up are hidden.
